svg.title: Pi TimeLens Step summaries in a real narrow Pi terminal
svg.desc: A faithful transcript redraw from Pi 0.85.1 at 40 columns. Compact Step and Total summaries keep response latency and strict text TTFT distinct while reflowing complete timing and token segments.
svg.metadata: Faithful redraw of tests/fixtures/real-pi-40.txt, selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 40 columns on 2026-09-09. Raw capture SHA-256: a0c46032d26db58943fa23ba0ff44987309bd0471930b0f45a3c089db4dcfda2. Transcript text, wrapping, ordering, measured values, and theme roles are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, model identifier, filesystem path, and assistant reasoning are omitted.
